results.previous_best: O(n \log n) comparisons (Franceschini's stable in-place sorting algorithm)
results.quote: Albeit its running time of O(_n_log<sup>2</sup>_n_) is not quite optimal, it still works efficiently, both in theory using the optimal number of O(_n_log_n_) comparisons and in practice with low constants, while being easily comprehensible.
On that account, the total running time of _in-place Mergesort_ consequently becomes O(_n_log<sup>2</sup>_n_).
Both prerequisites work with O(1) additional space and the usual recursion necessitates only an additional O(_log_n_) space for the stack.
